# Resource: stripe_tax_id

A tax ID of your own account or of a customer, set by `owner`. Stripe does not update tax IDs, so every argument forces replacement. `terraform destroy` deletes the tax ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_customer" "acme" {
  name = "Acme GmbH"
}

resource "stripe_tax_id" "acme_vat" {
  type  = "eu_vat"
  value = "DE123456789"

  owner = {
    type     = "customer"
    customer = stripe_customer.acme.id
  }
}
```

* `value` - (Required) Value of the tax ID. Changing it replaces the resource.

The following arguments are optional:

* `owner` - (Optional) The account or customer the tax ID belongs to. Defaults to `owner[type]=self`. Changing it replaces the resource. See [`owner`](#owner) below.

<a id="owner"></a>
### `owner`

The `owner` attribute supports:

* `account` - (Read-Only) The account being referenced when `type` is `account`.
* `application` - (Read-Only) The Connect Application being referenced when `type` is `application`.
* `customer` - (Optional) The customer being referenced when `type` is `customer`.
* `customer_account` - (Read-Only) The Account representing the customer being referenced when `type` is `customer`.
* `type` - (Required) Type of owner referenced. Possible values: `account`, `application`, `customer`, `self`.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `country` - Two-letter ISO code representing the country of the tax ID.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `customer` - ID of the customer.
* `customer_account` - ID of the Account representing the customer.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `verification` - Tax ID verification information. See [`verification`](#verification) below.

<a id="verification"></a>
### `verification`

The `verification` attribute supports:

* `status` - Verification status, one of `pending`, `verified`, `unverified`, or `unavailable`. Possible values: `pending`, `unavailable`, `unverified`, `verified`.
* `verified_address` - Verified address.
* `verified_name` - Verified name.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a tax id using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_tax_id.acme_vat
  id = "txi_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_tax_id.acme_vat
  identity = {
    id = "txi_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the tax id.

Using `terraform import`, import a tax id using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_tax_id.acme_vat txi_123
```
